findings.reason: F0003:S2:T4:A68 supplies the original source identifier, DOI and table reference, but the supplied item does not explicitly name the drug, analyte or workbook. DR01 is partially supported; project context alone does not establish those source-level identities.
findings.needed_material: Confirm the item-to-workbook and source-to-voriconazole/analyte mapping through authorized provenance review before accepting the record for use.

findings.reason: F0003:S2:T4:A69 provides dose, route, planned sampling times, matrices, assays and a plasma LLOQ. The body supplies fitted parameters rather than concentration-time observations. Actual versus nominal sampling times, explicit time origin, animal identifiers, sampling structure, observation-level censoring and missingness, and plasma total/unbound basis are not provided. This item alone cannot establish modeling-input sufficiency or dose- or time-dependent kinetics.
findings.needed_material: Authorized source-linked concentration records and dosing histories, with sampling design, identifiers where available, time definitions, concentration basis and missingness metadata; retain reported estimates separately.

findings.reason: F0003:S2:T4:A70 explicitly states that VM is printed in μg/ml, kM was fixed from a previous study, and covariate, residual-error and AIC rows were unconfirmed and omitted. Parameter equations, full compartment mappings and the fixed-parameter provenance are not supplied. The Estimate column has row-specific units; its unit list does not imply a common unit. Missing RSE and variability cells must remain missing, with the meaning of NA retained separately.
findings.needed_material: Review the authorized model definitions and fixed-kM provenance; confirm the printed VM unit without correction or conversion, and establish which reported estimates are usable for the downstream objective. Numerical model adequacy remains a later-stage question.

findings.reason: F0003:S2:T4:A71 supplies rat plasma protein-binding percentages, healthy/infected distinctions, ultrafiltration and three test concentrations. Temperature, pH, recovery, nonspecific binding, mass balance, the statistical meaning of ±, concentration-specific binding results and explicit analyte identity are not supplied. These are bound-percentage summaries, not directly measured free concentrations or reported fu values; no conversion was performed.
findings.needed_material: Review authorized binding methods and summary definitions, confirm concentration and biological applicability for the requested endpoint, and obtain blood/plasma partition information only if the intended use changes that basis. Carry the text-only binding values to preparation for confirmation.

findings.needed_material: Carry MI004 unchanged to pk for explicit source-by-analysis applicability decisions and documented fu sensitivity scenarios, preserving the conflicting mouse quantities and their matrices. Binding-dependent acceptance remains pending.

findings.reason: MI006 remains OPEN with status DEFERRED, originating at main:/missing_information/items/5, needed_at pk. DR11 has candidate evidence in the reported Interindividual variability column, but its scale, distribution and parameterization are unspecified. Adjacent RSE columns describe estimate uncertainty, not individual variability. No verified individual records or serial/destructive sampling structure are supplied.
findings.needed_material: Carry MI006 unchanged to pk. Review the authorized variability definitions, original sampling structure and individual-record support before estimating or propagating individual PK variability; keep published IIV estimates distinct from their RSE and report unsupported variability without inventing it.

findings.reason: The item supplies rat-only reported parameter candidates, separate healthy and infected contexts, per-animal volume units and a 150-350 g weight range. It supplies neither individual or group-specific actual study weights nor complete parameter definitions and translation applicability decisions. A weight range does not justify substituting a representative weight, and candidate coverage does not qualify a species for translation.
findings.needed_material: Reuse the reviewed rat parameter inventory, retain infection-state and unit distinctions, and obtain source-linked actual weights and any correction inputs required by the explicitly considered translation approach before translation.
